nodes.label: Rules of Hooks — Never Violate
nodes.rationale: React hooks must only be called at the top level of a component. Placing hooks inside nested functions, conditionals, or loops caused real bugs in Dashboard.jsx that were corrected by Base44 bot.

nodes.label: Material Symbols Instead of Lucide React
nodes.rationale: The project migrated from lucide-react to Material Symbols Outlined for visual icons. Lucide-react is retained only for action icons (Pencil, Trash2, Copy) in legacy components.

nodes.label: Migration from shadcn Card to Design System Tokens
nodes.rationale: The project is migrating from shadcn/ui Card/CardContent components to direct divs with design_lumen.md tokens (bg-surface, border-surface-border, p-card-padding) for consistency with the design system.

nodes.label: LocalStorage Data Validation Rule
nodes.rationale: getLocal() returns JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(...)) which may return corrupted data of unexpected type. Always validate with Array.isArray() or type checks before using localStorage data. Apply validation both at the store function level and in consuming components.
